raw_response.rationale: The full text (24 pages) combines a doctrinal legal analysis of water economic valuation and municipal tariff schedules in Puerto Vallarta (Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Ley Federal de Derechos, RPSPAPDATDARMPV, and Ley de Ingresos 2025) with two cross-sectional user perception surveys of SEAPAL-VALLARTA customers (n = 364 domestic/commercial/industrial users and n = 100 hotel users). Empirical reporting consists exclusively of statutory fee tables (Tables 1-2, 4), descriptive maximum bill examples (Table 3), and raw counts/percentages in bar and pie charts (Figures 3-7; e.g., 60% vs. 38% perceiving tariffs as affordable vs. high, and 66.20% of D.C.I. users vs. 91% of hotel users feeling secure in supply upon payment). No inferential statistics, regression coefficients, chi-square tests, standard errors, confidence intervals, or p-values are reported anywhere in the paper.
